def periodic_pair_umbrella_energy(
    positions: Array,
    box_lengths: Array,
    center: float,
    force_constant: float,
) -> Array:
    """Evaluate a harmonic pair-distance bias with the minimum-image rule."""

    displacement = positions[1] - positions[0]
    displacement -= box_lengths * jnp.round(displacement / box_lengths)
    distance = jnp.linalg.norm(displacement)
    return 0.5 * force_constant * (distance - center) ** 2


positions = jnp.array([[1.0, 1.0, 1.0], [4.6, 1.0, 1.0]])
box_lengths = jnp.array([30.0, 30.0, 30.0])
bias_energy = periodic_pair_umbrella_energy(positions, box_lengths, 3.4, 0.015)
bias_forces = -jax.grad(periodic_pair_umbrella_energy)(
    positions, box_lengths, 3.4, 0.015
)
print(f"bias energy={float(bias_energy):.6f} eV")
print(f"force on atom 1={bias_forces[1].tolist()} eV/angstrom")
print(f"net bias force={jnp.sum(bias_forces, axis=0).tolist()} eV/angstrom")
